heroTitle: One partner for office print & brand collateral
heroBody: Visiting cards, ID kits, letterheads, pamphlets, and signage — tailored to your quantity. Pricing is shared after you request a quote.

features.title: Bulk quote & MOQ
features.body: Share quantity and specs — we respond with volume pricing, proofs, and a clear timeline. No checkout pressure.

features.title: Brand consistency
features.body: Matched colours across visiting cards, letterheads, envelopes, and campaign print for one brand look.

features.title: Artwork support
features.body: Upload print-ready files or brief our desk. We review bleed, resolution, and colour before production.

features.title: ID & onboarding kits
features.body: Employee ID cards, lanyards, and welcome packs — ideal for HR teams and new joiner batches.

features.title: Campaign print
features.body: Pamphlets, standees, and event collateral with flexible quantities for marketing and field teams.

features.title: Dedicated follow-up
features.body: A named contact from our BTM team — phone, WhatsApp, and email until delivery is confirmed.

solutions.title: HR & admin
solutions.body: ID kits, letterheads, and onboarding stationery for growing teams.

solutions.title: Marketing
solutions.body: Pamphlets, signage, and launch print with volume-friendly pricing.

solutions.title: Offices & retail
solutions.body: Consistent brand touchpoints across branches and store fronts.

solutions.title: Events & gifting
solutions.body: Custom envelopes, calendars, and branded collateral for milestones.
